title: He Pulled His Rice to Make It Grow Faster 🌱 | A Fable, Sung
tiktok_title: His rice grew too slow. So he pulled on it.
caption:
His rice grew too slow… so one night he pulled every sprout a little higher. 🌱 What do you think he found at sunrise? An old fable about patience.

#talesinink #moralstories #fable #ukiyoe #shorts #patience #growth #storytime
moral: You cannot hurry what must grow.
